title: ER-EDF: A Psychology-Grounded Emotion Regulation Framework for Speech Empathetic Dialogue Generation in Large Audio-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.15089v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Empathetic response generation in spoken dialogue systems requires both accurate emotion perception and appropriate emotion regulation. Grounded in psychological theories such as the Perception-Action Model and emotion regulation theory, effective empathy depends not only on inferring a user's affective state but also on regulating how it is expressed in responses. However, recent large audio-language models (LALMs) largely treat emotion as a direct conditioning signal, lacking explicit regulatory mechanisms, which often leads to affect mirroring rather than calibrated support. We propose ER-EDF, a psychology-grounded framework that explicitly decouples emotion perception and emotion regulation in LALMs. Perception tracks the user's emotional state, while regulation determines how this state should guide empathetic response generation. translated_title: ER-EDF：一种基于心理学的情感调节框架，用于大型音频-语言模型中的语音共情对话生成
translated_abstract: 口语对话系统中的共情回复生成既需要准确的情感感知，也需要恰当的情感调节。基于感知-行动模型和情感调节理论等心理学理论，有效的共情不仅依赖于推断用户的情感状态，还依赖于调节该状态在回复中的表达方式。然而，近期的大型音频-语言模型（LALMs）大多将情感视为直接的条件信号，缺乏显式的调节机制，这往往导致情感镜像而非经过校准的支持。我们提出了ER-EDF，一个基于心理学理论的框架，它在大型音频-语言模型中显式地将情感感知与情感调节解耦。感知模块追踪用户的情感状态，而调节模块决定该状态应如何引导共情回复的生成。该框架与具体模型无关，可无缝集成到现有的大型音频-语言模型中。我们还进一步构建了一个（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出基于心理学理论的ER-EDF框架，通过显式解耦情感感知与情感调节，使大型音频-语言模型能够生成经过恰当校准的共情回复，而非简单镜像用户情绪。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ER-EDF, a psychology-grounded framework that explicitly decouples emotion perception and emotion regulation in large audio-language models, enabling calibrated empathetic responses rather than mere affect mirroring.
